none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained root-finding for a differentiable, potentially nonmonotone operator F:E→E satisfying a weak Minty condition. No scalar objective or saddle-point representation is required.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact operator-value and full Jacobian evaluations, requested separately. Each query returns either (F(x),0) or (0,J(x)); both consume the same oracle budget. Answers are exact for every call index and seed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: An arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its induced norm; no dimension-dependent restriction is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: F is globally L₁-Lipschitz and its Fréchet derivative J is globally L₂-Lipschitz in operator norm. There exists xstar with F(xstar)=0, ‖x0−xstar‖≤R, and ⟨F(x),x−xstar⟩≥−(ρ/2)‖F(x)‖² for every x. Parameters satisfy L₁,L₂,ε>0, R,ρ≥0, and ρL₁<2. E,L₁,L₂,ρ,ε,x0 are public; R is hidden from algorithm construction.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/WeakMintySecondOrder.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The residual guarantee holds almost surely under the joint algorithm-seed and oracle-seed law, after a fixed oracle budget.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: Return one point x with unsquared operator residual ‖F(x)‖≤ε; no averaging, last-iterate, or distance-to-solution requirement is imposed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The formulation combines nonmonotone weak-Minty root-finding across ρL₁<2 with Lipschitz Jacobians and separate exact operator/Jacobian queries. This is a specialized structured variant of root-finding; the classification does not establish novelty.
